entries.title: I Chronicles 8:1
segments: And Benjamin fathered Bela his first-born, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:2
segments: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:3
segments: And the sons of Bela: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:4
segments: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:5
segments: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:6
segments: And these [are] the sons of Ehud, these are the heads of the fathers of the people of Geba; and they exiled them to Manahath.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:7
segments: And Naaman and Ahiah and Gera, he exiled them. And Ehud fathered Uzza and Ahihud.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:8
segments: And Shaharaim fathered [sons] in the land of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara [were] his wives.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:9
segments: And by his wife Hodesh, [were] Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:10
segments: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These [were] his sons, heads of the fathers.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:11
segments: And by Hushim he had Abitub, and Elpaal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:12
segments: The sons of Elpaal [were] Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono and Lod, with their towns.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:13
segments: And Beriah and Shema [were] heads of the fathers of the people of Aijalon, who drove away the people of Gath;

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:14
segments: and Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:15
segments: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:16
segments: and Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:17
segments: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:18
segments: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab [were] the sons of Elpaal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:19
segments: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:20
segments: and Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:21
segments: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath [were] the sons of Shimhi.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:22
segments: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:23
segments: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:24
segments: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:25
segments: and Iphedeiah, and Penuel [were] the sons of Shashak.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:26
segments: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:27
segments: and Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri [were] the sons of Jeroham.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:28
segments: These [were] heads of the fathers, by their generations, chiefs. These lived in Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:29
segments: And at Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, whose wife's name [was] Maachah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:30
segments: And his first-born son [was] Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:31
segments: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:32
segments: And Mikloth fathered Shimeah. And these also lived with their brothers in Jerusalem, across from them.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:33
segments: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul. And Saul fathered Jonathan, and Malchishua and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:34
segments: And the son of Jonathan [was] Meribbaal. And Meribbaal fathered Micah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:35
segments: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:36
segments: And Ahaz fathered Jehoadah. And Jehoadah fathered Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri. And Zimri fathered Moza.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:37
segments: And Moza fathered Binea; Rapha [was] his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:38
segments: And Azel [had] six sons, and these their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these [were] the sons of Azel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:39
segments: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his first-born; Jehush, the second; and Eliphelet, the third.

entries.title: I Chronicles 8:40
segments: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these [were] the sons of Benjamin.
